Resolves #19406

The Atlas keeps the sunset gate and drops its own copy of the threshold: human confirmation is required unless trigger 1 of the `session-sunset` skill's workflow holds. The sentence is true with today's skill and with neomjs/neo-agent-skills#146, so merge order is free.

Evidence: L1 (static text) → L1 required (no runtime-verify ACs). No residuals.

Micro-review eligible: mechanical — one clause in one documentation line.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the commit ran the repository's lint-staged guards.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `learn/agentos/AGENTS_ATLAS.md:110` names the skill's trigger 1; the diff is that one line |
| AC-2 | outside-CI: `grep -n "75" learn/agentos/AGENTS_ATLAS.md` returns no sunset threshold |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive.

## Slot rationale and load effect

The Atlas is read on demand through AGENTS.md's edge-case line, never per turn. Disposition `rewrite`: the line stays a one-clause summary of the gate, and the number moves to its single home, the skill's workflow §1. +26 bytes.
